text:
Predicates:
UnsupervisedLearning(x) ::: x is an unsupervised learning algorithm.
StateOfTheArtModel(y) ::: y is the state-of-the-art text summarization model.
TrainedWith(x, y) ::: x is used to train y.
RequiresLabelledData(x) ::: x requires labelled data.
Uses(x, y) ::: x uses y.
Premises:
∀x (UnsupervisedLearning(x) → ¬RequiresLabelledData(x)) ::: Unsupervised learning doesn't require labelled data.
∀x (TrainedWith(x, y) → MachineLearning(x)) ::: The state-of-the-art text summarization model is trained with machine learning algorithms.
∀x (ReinforcementLearning(x) → ¬TrainedWith(x, y)) ::: Reinforcement learning is not used to train the model.
∀x (MachineLearning(x) → RequiresLabelledData(x)) ::: Machine learning algorithms for training require labelled data.
Conclusion:
UnsupervisedLearning(y) ::: Unsupervised learning is used to train the model.
